# B"H — Social Kernel Entity (geelooy/api/social/helper/socialKernel/entity/)

Entity layer of the social kernel.

## Files
- `SocialEntityLoader.js` — loads social entities.
- `SocialEntityNormalizer.js` — normalizes entity records.
- `SocialEntityType.js` — entity type definitions.
